title: finding(core): two more claims in `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES`' docblock describe a tree this repo cannot reach — the server's expand path, and a forward-compatibility prediction
body:
Found while doing objectui#8693, which removed one uncheckable claim from this docblock (`packages/core/src/utils/expand-fields.ts`, over `EXPANDABLE_FIELD_TYPES`). objectui#8693's brief asked for the *list* of remaining ones rather than their repair, so this card records the list. Nothing here is known to be false — the point is that nothing can tell.

The defect class objectui#8693 established: a claim written in `@object-ui/core` about a component that `@object-ui/core` does not depend on has no mechanism that can fail when it goes stale. It had gone stale, silently, for as long as `UserCellRenderer` existed.

## The two remaining ones

**1. The server's expand path.**

> `user` is a lookup specialised to `sys_user`: it carries the same `reference` + id storage and the server resolves it through the same expand path as `lookup` / `master_detail`

The second half is a claim about objectql, a different repository. Nothing in objectui exercises a real server here: `expand-fields.test.ts` asserts what `buildExpandFields` puts into `$expand`, never what a server does with it. If objectql ever resolved `user` through a different path, every test in this repo stays green.

This one is load-bearing in a way the removed sentence was not — it is the stated reason `user` belongs in the set at all — so the useful move is probably not deletion but an anchor: a cross-repo pin, or a pointer to whichever objectql test settles it.

**2. The `tree` note's forward-compatibility prediction.**

> Note on `tree`: ... whether the backend materialises the expanded object for it is a server concern — requesting it is harmless and forward-compatible.

"Harmless" is a claim about a server response, same as (1). "Forward-compatible" is a claim about servers that do not exist yet, and is not checkable even in principle. `tree` is nevertheless a full member of the set, so this sentence is carrying a membership decision.

## Two weaker ones, listed for completeness

- **"That was true for 15 days."** — a duration about two sets that have since diverged. Re-deriving it needs archaeology across two retired commits, and nothing notices if it drifts. Harmless, but it is the same species: a hand-kept fact with no keeper.
- **The `object-ref` / `filter-condition` / `recipient-picker` exclusion** — this one is nearly fine. It is anchored: `widgetHintOnly: true` in `app-shell/src/utils/paramValueShape.ts`, measured present on `da5e4f69e` (4 occurrences, three of them those names). What is missing is only the link in the other direction — nothing fails if that table changes and this paragraph does not.

## What is NOT on this list

The consumer enumeration in the same docblock **was** stale — by four, from objectui#5874 / #6064 — and objectui#8693 corrected it in place and added a re-derivation recipe. Not repeated here.

## Suggested scope

Decide per claim: anchor it, move it to where a test can reach it, or drop it and keep the half the set depends on. (1) is the only one with real weight; (2) is a membership rationale that currently rests on a prediction.

Filed with no assignee, for PM triage. Generated by Claude Code, session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S`, on branch `claude/issue-8693-expand-fields-rendering-claim`.
